content.value_statement: Campaign teams often need repeatable social content plans across many platforms. This skill turns client goals into structured scripts, captions, visuals, and posting maps.
actual_capabilities: Creates campaign overviews with goals, personas, and target platforms.
Generates 10 to 30 video or post concepts with hooks and script outlines.
Maps each idea to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Facebook formats.
Suggests thumbnails, text overlays, B-roll ideas, and visual styles.
Builds weekly posting maps with recommended publishing windows.
Structures playbook content for later storage in social campaign tables.
limitations: It does not publish posts or manage social media accounts.
It does not create final video files, screenshots, or graphic assets.
It needs client goals, audience details, and brand tone for best results.
It does not validate database schemas or insert records by itself.

use_cases.title: Plan a Client Launch
use_cases.description: Create a launch playbook with platform-specific videos, captions, thumbnails, and a weekly cadence.

use_cases.title: Build a Local Business Content Library
use_cases.description: Turn service offers into practical content ideas for short video, long video, and social posts.

use_cases.title: Standardize Campaign Production
use_cases.description: Define repeatable formats, scripts, and visual directions for a content operations team.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Campaign Playbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a social media playbook for a client in [industry]. The goal is [goal]. Include platforms, audience, 10 ideas, hooks, captions, and a weekly schedule.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt Ideas Across Platforms
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these campaign ideas into formats for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Facebook. Keep the tone [tone] and prioritize [audience].

prompt_templates.title: Design a Monthly Content System
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-day content system for [client]. Include themes, post formats, script outlines, thumbnail concepts, cadence, and storage-ready fields.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an Existing Playbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this playbook for [client]. Improve the hooks, remove weak ideas, tighten the cadence, and align every item with [business objective].

output_examples.input: Create a playbook for a plumbing company that wants more emergency service calls.
output: Campaign overview focused on urgent homeowner problems and local trust.
Video ideas include leak warning signs, before-and-after repairs, and quick maintenance checks.
Platform mappings convert each idea into short video, long video, carousel, and LinkedIn formats.
Weekly cadence balances urgent tips, proof posts, and service reminders.

output_examples.input: Build a campaign for a SaaS feature launch targeting agency owners.
output: Launch narrative explains the feature, the workflow problem, and the business outcome.
Scripts include demo walkthroughs, objection handling, founder clips, and customer proof.
Thumbnail concepts use clear feature names and outcome-focused text overlays.
Posting plan sequences teaser, launch, education, proof, and follow-up content.

output_examples.input: Improve an existing content plan for a consulting offer.
output: Weak generic topics are replaced with sharper client pain points.
Hooks are shortened for the first five seconds of each video.
LinkedIn posts are reframed for authority and buyer trust.
Cadence is adjusted to support lead generation without repeating the same message.

best_practices: Provide the client industry, offer, audience, brand tone, and campaign goal before generating the playbook.
Ask for platform-specific mappings so each idea fits the format and audience behavior.
Review scripts and captions for compliance, client claims, and factual accuracy before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for generic viral ideas without a clear audience or business goal.
Do not treat the playbook as final legal, medical, financial, or compliance advice.
Do not publish outputs without human review for brand fit and factual claims.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates structured social media playbooks with campaign goals, content ideas, scripts, captions, thumbnails, and cadence.

faq.question: Which platforms does it support?
faq.answer: It supports planning for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

faq.question: Can it publish content automatically?
faq.answer: No. It plans content and structure, but it does not publish posts or manage accounts.

faq.question: Does it create final images or videos?
faq.answer: No. It suggests visual directions, thumbnails, and B-roll ideas for a production team to create.

faq.question: What input improves the output?
faq.answer: Provide the client offer, audience, brand tone, core proof points, preferred platforms, and campaign goal.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
